evidence_boundary.canonical_source: The 122 Markdown files under apps/showcase/server/assets/llms/{pages,components} at source_commit are the canonical discovery corpus, not a count of runtime components. source_kind and counts.pages/components name upstream directories; components/laravel, components/mcp and components/team are host/research/organization pages, not UI components.

source_reconciliation.scope: All 122 local upstream snapshot files match the recorded UTF-8 byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes, and their Git blob SHA-1 identities match the public pinned tree. The canonical Markdown path set equals the ledger source set, including the single normalized exclusion. This reconciles source identity only; it does not execute documentation examples or certify their APIs.
source_reconciliation.normalized_exclusion: The excluded row's Git blob identity and original inventory-ID hash reconcile against the pinned tree without restoring the excluded raw identity to the installed ledger.

identity_layers.source: Per-row sha256 and bytes identify pinned official source bytes, never the current authored reference.
identity_layers.native: Per-row native maps, native_fingerprint, rubric, input_cap, escalation and discovery identities preserve the historical discovery run; they are not fresh judgments.
identity_layers.authored: final_reference, disposition, reason and release_conflicts are mutable authored semantic routing. Reference edits require a fresh routing/reason review and refreshed current packaged-file hashes, not replacement of source hashes or native fingerprints.
identity_layers.execution: Only assets/verification.json owns bounded executed observations. Canonical source completeness, a documented disposition, an escalation closure or a hash match is not browser, GPU, SSR, hydration, accessibility, optional-peer or future-major certification.

evidence_boundary.escalation_interpretation: The frozen owner-probability threshold refers to native.owner.probabilities[native.owner.choice] < 0.75, not native.owner.confidence. Combined with owner=review/migration_only/background, risk=high/unknown, errors and truncation, it reproduces all 80 escalated IDs. Truncation is UTF-8-decoded source character length > input_cap and reproduces all 21 truncated IDs.
historical_limits: The pinned canonical Markdown source is available and freshly identity-reconciled. The exact original native request payloads, model execution, capability-author handoffs and original review actions were not replayed or independently re-observed; the method and native maps remain historical provenance.
No deleted legacy .agents/skills input was read or reconstructed. A retained historical identity or native judgment must not be described as a fresh read of an inaccessible original input.

Release-conflict text and reasons can describe prior bounded observations or prepared examples; this source/routing reconciliation does not rerun those observations. Reconcile changed owner guidance with its primary release sources before refreshing authored coverage.
An empty unresolved array denotes authored routing closure for this corpus, not universal runtime acceptance. Actual browser/GPU-dependent outcomes remain subject to the final human gate.

method: Freeze every pinned official Markdown input identity and original native owner/risk map. Use the four capability-author handoffs for 72 final semantic dispositions; inspect the remaining 50 official documents and their setup, architecture and component references for final documented/context-only/excluded decisions. Reconcile conflicts recorded by authors against the reference contracts. Native hypotheses are routing inputs, never final ownership or API certification. Documented means substantive reference coverage, including deliberate limitations; context_only means research, history or an incumbent boundary without a complete positive implementation recipe; excluded means no implementation offering. Reasons describe reference content and prepared consumers, not executed checks. No native probability, label, reference example, proposed scenario or successful build certifies the complete component suite, accessibility, hydration, server isolation or future majors. Only assets/verification.json owns bounded executed evidence.

owner.instructions: Assign one official OpenVue documentation page to the primary new Vue Kit capability owner. Judge actual page content, not just filename. This is discovery routing, not API/runtime certification. Classify migration/obsolete aliases as migration_only, marketing/external examples as background, and ambiguous/cross-cutting cases as review.

criteria.theming: Styled/unstyled, design tokens/presets, CSS layers, pass through, accessibility styling, icon configuration.
criteria.forms: Input/select/date/number/password/rich editor/file field semantics, forms/resolvers/field validation.
criteria.overlays: Dialog/drawer/popover/confirm/dynamic dialog/toast/tooltip overlay services and focus lifecycle.
criteria.migration_only: Explicitly deprecated legacy component/API alias or narrowly old migration material, not positive greenfield offering.
criteria.background: Organization/contribution/licensing/announcement/marketing or external showcase products, not a core implementation contract.
criteria.review: Cannot safely assign or content crosses ownership ambiguously.

risk.instructions: Identify whether the page needs exact published-release/declaration/runtime reconciliation before teaching it. An ordinary page may still require validation; this label prioritizes investigation rather than establishing correctness.

criteria.normal: Mostly stable display/layout or straightforward local API.

escalation: Review owner=review/migration_only/background, owner probability below0.75, risk=high/unknown, and every error/truncation. Every official page gets a final owner/exclusion disposition; no label certifies runtime.
native_fingerprint_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON for {row.id:{sha256:row.sha256,native:row.native}}, serialized with sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False. IDs are emitted audit IDs, including the normalized excluded input; native objects are unchanged.

source_identity_normalization.policy: One excluded vendor-comparison marketing document projects to this safe ID. Its raw source path, title and original URL are omitted. source_identity_sha256 hashes the original UTF-8 inventory ID; source_blob_sha1 hashes the original bytes with the Git blob header. The HTTPS GitHub blob API URL preserves retrievable source identity without embedding the excluded vendor spelling. Original sha256, bytes and native owner/risk maps are retained.

review_boundary: All 21 truncated native inputs and all 80 escalated hypotheses receive final semantic dispositions. Truncation describes the original 26000-character native input cap, not a permission to discard remaining source content. Escalation closure establishes reviewed ownership or exclusion only; it is not runtime acceptance or a declaration that known upstream limitations were fixed.
